What’s new on the site

The University map has more six-day paths (including broken relationships, comparison and contentment, anger and a quiet tongue, honest regret, honest doubt, and gall, root, and peace); a five-day quiet fall harvest, a late-summer bridge of thanks and rest, and late fall, quiet winter before Advent; a four-night Evening in the University with a one-page print, a morning & evening two-card print, and a one-week family sheet (also listed on Simple family rhythm); calmer verse-image preset filters; and Family Armor’s morning reset beside the bedtime card.

      Ribbon journal

      Quiet lines for the Möbius path—which station you were near, what breath you needed, what the Lord showed you. Same gentle store as the Möbius room; stays on this device. No dates on screen, no streaks, no schedule.

      Gentle prompts (optional)
      • Which turn on the ribbon felt closest today—fear, weariness, conscience, or peace?
      • One inhale you spoke honestly; one exhale from Scripture you received.
      • What small step might love look like before the day ends?
      • If the waves were loud: who is in the boat with you?

      What stays on this device

      No raw storage dump—just an honest scope. This browser may keep: saved verse list, verse notes and tags, ribbon journal lines (Möbius path), plan-day reflections (“what stood out”), prayer text you type here, highlight marks, memorize review times, recent reader chapters, and gentle activity dots for the month view. Signed-in sync uses your account only for that feature; we do not sell data.

      Use Download JSON backup below when you switch phones or want a file in your own hands. That file includes saved verses, workspace notes, highlights, ribbon journal, plan reflections, and Bible Tool notes.
